The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Hot Buttered Apples are made by [[Cooking]] an [[Apple]] and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The sweetness of the Apple has been enhanced by smothering it with Goat Butter and baking it. During the [[Side Quest]] "[[Cooking with Koko]]", [[Koko]] decides to make Hot Buttered Apples, since her mother used to make them and her sister [[Cottla]] loves them.{{Cite|What should Koko make now... {{Big|OH!}} {{Color BotW|Blue|Hot buttered apple}} sounds good! Mother used to make it all the time! Cottla loves it too! Let's see... The ingredients are... some {{Color BotW|Blue|apples}} and...{{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}?|Koko|BotW}} However, she realizes that she has run out of Goat Butter, and therefore cannot make the [[Meal]].{{Cite|{{Big|OH, NO!!}} Koko is out of {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}...|Koko|BotW}} When Link brings her Goat Butter, Koko will be excited, thanking him and making sure he means it.{{Cite|Is this... {{Big|goat butter?!}} Are you sure about this? Really? Thank you so much! Koko means it! Stay right there for a second!|Koko|BotW}} She then makes a Hot Buttered Apple, which she gives to Link as a reward.{{Cite|Mmm! What a yummy smell! And that hint of butter makes all the difference! Oh! Oh! And the apples are superbly sweet too! Here, take some. It's really something else.|Koko|BotW}} Additional [[Ingredient]]s can be added when making Hot Buttered Apples, which can result in one of the following variations: * '''Chilly Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Enduring Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Hot Buttered Apple}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. They completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when consumed. * '''Energizing Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Hot Buttered Apple}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. When eaten, they temporarily increase Link's speed. * '''Hearty Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Hot Buttered Apple}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating them will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Link gains a boost to the power of his attacks when he eats these apples. * '''Sneaky Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they grant Link a boost to his [[Stealth]] temporarily. * '''Spicy Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Eating these apples will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Hot Buttered Apple''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Hot Buttered Apple}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The apple's sweetness has been enhanced by smothering it with butter and baking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's [[Defense]] for a short period of time. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} A ''[[Tattered Notebook]]'' written by [[Cottla]]'s mother can be found in the [[Secret Base]], providing instructions on how to [[Cooking|Cook]] the family's favorite [[Food]]s. Inside, Cottla's mother noted that her daughter had a particular fondness for Hot Buttered Apples and listed the Ingredients used to make them.{{Cite|My little Cottla. My perfect girl. I love her so very much. She truly is the apple of my eye!

Speaking of apples, she seems to have quite the taste for {{Color TotK|Red|hot buttered apple}}.

She's like an adorable little squirrel, always stuffing her cheeks full of them!

If I could, I would only cook endless amounts of {{Color TotK|Red|apples}} and {{Color TotK|Red|goat butter}} to keep my little one happy.|Tattered Notebook|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Honeyed Apple * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
